nonBlockingObservations: On the inspected desktop league every one of the seven Roster Window Map rooms reads `aging` with a negative NEXT YEAR projection. This is pre-existing and NOT introduced by S90: buildRosterWindowMap's expectedDevelopment models ageFactor + traitFactor only and has never included the club environment term, and S90 did not change it. S90 in fact makes this surface more truthful than before — the engine previously added an undeclared +0.84 on top, so a room the UI called `aging` at -1.0 actually developed at -0.16 or better; now the engine really does move rooms by roughly the declared curve. The remaining issue is that a classifier whose seven rooms all report the same band carries no information, and that its per-room projection assumes the league-average (zero) environment tilt rather than the player's own club's. Recorded for S91, non-blocking: it misinforms nobody about a shipped behaviour, it is simply uninformative.
